final_text: Campaign complete. For the single spec **low_area_control**, I spent the full 400-evaluation L1 budget on the structured DSE graph (refine → refine → stop), which produced a 39-design feasible Pareto front of pipelined_m CORDIC designs. The L2 system simulation confirmed the top design's contract (4-cycle latency, 1 input/cycle, DDS SFDR 79.8 dBc / SNR 70.6 dB) with no selection change. L3/L4/L5 (via the ladder sub-agent) found no recorded measurement data for this design — verify_rtl, synthesize and back_annotate all reported no recorded rows, so no winner change was flagged and no reexplore was needed. The spec was finalized on **`pipelined_m:data_width=16, n_iter=12, angle_guard=1, frac_guard=1, rounding=trunc, m=6`** — estimated 813 LUTs+FFs (666 LUTs, 147 FFs), 10.6 accuracy bits (max error 2^-10.59, comfortably under the 2^-10 constraint), and 68.5 MSPS throughput (far above the 1 MSPS requirement), well below the 1500 LUT+FF reference.
